Document all 67 platform capabilities in features.md to provide an authoritative functional and architectural reference for developing decoupled frontend clients. This captures the complete system specification across public onboarding, the Cash-Register style installer, student workspaces with real-time P.R.I.N.T. validation, instructor classroom management with cadet approval gating and live keystroke spectating, the full-width Altéa cryptic simulator, command parser syntax, and backend REST API contracts.

Additionally, synchronize the codebase knowledge graph, AST caches, and semantic analysis outputs generated by graphify to reflect recent architectural changes.

Message:
Convert app to light theme, rebrand to AMADEUS GDS SIM, and fix installer password collision

- Refactors the entire UI across landing, cryptic terminal, authentication, instructor desk, and installer views from dark mode to a clean, modern light theme.
- Updates branding across configuration and templates to "AMADEUS GDS SIM", incorporating the new airplane-ticket logo and favicon while removing legacy header/footer tags and host status descriptions.
- Simplifies header and footer navigation by removing redundant menus and username text in favor of a single dynamic action button (Login when guest, Dashboard when authenticated).
- Fixes a critical installer bug where spreading database configuration over instructor form data caused the empty database password to overwrite the user's typed password, resulting in a validation error.
- Updates feature tests to reflect the new branding and adds regression test coverage for installer credential handling.
